source_row.stem: When setting up a sterile field, the outer 1-inch border of the sterile drape is considered:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"The most sterile part of the field","B":"Sterile and usable for placing items","C":"Unsterile, and items should not be placed within this border","D":"Irrelevant to sterile technique"}}
source_row.rationale: The outer 1-inch border of a sterile field/drape is considered unsterile due to potential contamination from contact with unsterile surfaces, so items should not be placed within this border.
source_row.source_name: Standard Nursing Fundamentals — Sterile Field Principles
